description: This Java class DefaultMapperLimitsConfig provides a configuration implementation for mapper limits, defining maximum counts for source mappers, inbound messages, target mappers, and outbound messages. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.mapping package and provides static methods to instantiate itself from a configuration object.

classes.name: DefaultMapperLimitsConfig
classes.description: Implements MapperLimitsConfig, encapsulating the configuration for mapper limits such as max source mappers, inbound/outbound messages, and target mappers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultMapperLimitsConfig from a given Config object, using a fallback mechanism.

methods.name: getMaxSourceMappers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of source mappers allowed.

methods.name: getMaxMappedInboundMessages
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of inbound messages that can be mapped.

methods.name: getMaxTargetMappers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of target mappers allowed.

methods.name: getMaxMappedOutboundMessages
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of outbound messages that can be mapped.
